email.subject: Your offer from Starling Mobility
email.body:
Hi,

I'm delighted to share that we'd like to offer you the Backend Engineer position at Starling Mobility!

Your offer letter is attached. In summary:
- Annual base salary: 1,450,000 TRY
- Start date: Monday, 4 January 2027
- 25 days of paid leave, private health insurance and a learning budget

Please let us know your decision by Friday, 6 November 2026. I'm happy to set up a call if you have any questions about the offer.

Congratulations!
Nadia Brooks
Talent Acquisition
